title: Citronellol silver nanoconjugates as a therapeutic strategy for glioblastoma through computational and experimental evaluation.
authors: Manzoor, Hina; Khan, Muhammad Umer; Khan, Samiullah; Haider, Nazima; Ullah, Muhammad Ikram; Ghanem, Heba Bassiony; Alameen, Ayman Ali Mohammed; Alhegaili, Alaa S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香茅醇银纳米缀合物对胶质母细胞瘤的细胞毒性，涉及小分子-蛋白对接与MD，但对象为药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Glioblastoma is the most prevalent type of brain tumor, and because of drug resistance, treatment for gliomas has been less successful. Citronellol is an acyclic monoterpene alcohol with various pharmacological properties. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of citronellol and its nanoformulation on glioblastoma cell proliferation. The physicochemical properties of citronellol and its synthesized silver nanoconjugates (CN@AgNPs) were evaluated using DFT and ADMET studies. The targets of the investigation (p53 and CDK4) were identified through the application of chemogenomics and analysis of the STRING protein-protein interaction network. Ligands were docked to the interaction sites of specific targets using AutoDock Vina 1.5.7. Molecular dynamics were used to mimic the citronellol complex CDK4 and p53. Because metallic bonds, which provide metals with unique strength and stability, are more resilient and long-lasting than hydrogen bonds, the results showed that the CN@AgNPs generated a more stable complex. Citronellol and CN@AgNPs were assessed by an in vitro study to determine the expression of IC50 concentration for the top scored selected genes to confirm the cytotoxicity of the compound against the GBM cell line SF-767. The findings showed that Citronellol and CN@AgNPs had concentration-dependent cytotoxic effects. Citronellol and CN@AgNPs, with IC50 values of 20.04 +/- 4 microg/mL and 19.67 +/- 4 microg/mL, respectively, decreased CDK4 expression and raised p53 expression in the SF-767 cancer cell line. In conclusion, the cytotoxicity and inhibition index of glioblastoma cells were increased by the phytocompounds coupled with AgNPs. Therefore, CN@AgNPs may be a good choice for treating cancer.
abstract_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤是最常见的脑肿瘤类型，由于耐药性，胶质瘤的治疗效果一直不太理想。香茅醇是一种无环单萜醇，具有多种药理特性。本研究旨在评估香茅醇及其纳米制剂对胶质母细胞瘤细胞增殖的影响。通过DFT和ADMET研究评估了香茅醇及其合成的银纳米缀合物（CN@AgNPs）的理化性质。通过应用化学基因组学和STRING蛋白-蛋白相互作用网络分析，确定了研究靶点（p53和CDK4）。使用AutoDock Vina 1.5.7将配体对接至特定靶点的相互作用位点。采用分子动力学模拟香茅醇复合物CDK4和p53。由于金属键赋予金属独特的强度和稳定性，比氢键更具弹性和持久性，结果表明CN@AgNPs形成了更稳定的复合物。通过体外研究评估了香茅醇和CN@AgNPs，以确定得分最高的选定基因的IC50浓度表达，从而确认该化合物对GBM细胞系SF-767的细胞毒性。结果显示，香茅醇和CN@AgNPs具有浓度依赖性的细胞毒性效应。香茅醇和CN@AgNPs的IC50值分别为20.04 +/- 4微克/毫升和19.67 +/- 4微克/毫升，在SF-767癌细胞系中降低了CDK4表达并提高了p53表达。总之，植物化合物与AgNPs结合增强了胶质母细胞瘤细胞的细胞毒性和抑制指数。因此，CN@AgNPs可能是治疗癌症的良好选择。
